summary: StripeWebhookService.handle submits reconcileCustomer to billingExecutor (a fixed pool with an unbounded queue) and the controller returns 200 without joining it. The only durable state is the EventReceipt row, and EventReceiptRepository has no query that would let anything re-derive pending reconciliations, so a restart drops the queued billing_customer update for good.

evidence.claim: The reconciliation is handed to an executor and not joined; handle then returns.
The caller receives 200 after handle returns, before the queued task has run.
The only query is a lookup by provider event id; there is no claim or pending-status query a sweeper could use to re-run reconciliation.

mitigationsChecked.name: durable claim before fork
mitigationsChecked.where: StripeWebhookService.handle:50; EventReceiptRepository has no claim query

mitigationsChecked.where: StripeWebhookService.handle:58 (log says accepted, no best-effort statement)

summary: spring.kafka.consumer.enable-auto-commit is true in application.yml and no override is visible in the packet, so the default listener factory commits offsets on a timer. Messages on care.pharmacy.medication-orders and care.billing.ledger-postings can therefore be acknowledged before their processing finishes, and a crash in that window loses them. The factory in BillingKafkaConfig could override the setting, but that file is not named in the packet.

evidence.claim: Auto commit is enabled under spring.kafka.consumer, which Spring Boot applies to the default listener container factory.
A @KafkaListener on a business topic with no manual acknowledgement, so it uses the auto-commit factory.

summary: fire returns 200 after handing recordAndPublishAfterCommit to an executor (billingExecutor per E2, a fixed pool with an unbounded queue) without waiting. The audit row is written only when that task runs, nothing is persisted before the submit, and nothing re-derives it, so a restart before the task runs loses the audit record and its Kafka event. Whether this audit matters to the business is judged from its name, hence medium confidence.

evidence.claim: The audit work is handed to an executor and not awaited; fire returns void right after.
The durable write happens only when the forked task runs.
The endpoint returns without any persisted claim or future.
